reply.summary: Rantirer is a cold-eyed marshal of a drowned-coast kingdom who serves the throne while quietly plotting to wear it; she trusts drilled soldiers and patient treachery over any gift of power.

feats.scene: Rantirer cleaves through a rival officer's shield with a single blade stroke during a palace coup.
Rantirer shrugs off a cavalry charge that slams her against a rampart wall.

reply.summary: Leorta is a recruit turned spymaster who survives a scrapheap duel with a weaponised alien machine by baiting it beside a truckload of explosives; she later runs a hidden bureau that hunts visitors from other worlds.

feats.scene: Leorta lures the metal horror next to the loaded truck and the blast leaves a crater where the yard once stood.
Leorta is thrown clear by the detonation and wakes up bruised but alive.

reply.summary: Lonuter is a twin from across the channel who wears a little raincloud badge on her outfit and calls up soaking downpours to flush foes out of cover; she speaks two languages and prefers drenching enemies to hurting them.

feats.scene: Lonuter gathers a heavy storm front over a refugee camp and drops a flood that sweeps attackers off their feet.
Lonuter takes a thrown crate on the shoulder and keeps singing to her clouds.

reply.summary: Lloti is a bald, mushroom-like space cop whose ring shapes glowing constructs, shields and bolts; he is rounded up with his peers and used as fuel for a tyrant's doomsday device.

feats.scene: Lloti fires a green bolt that cracks an asteroid-sized fortress wall.
Lloti hides behind a ring shield while a rival battery drains his reserves.

reply.summary: Torcor is a four-foot fungal being from a swamp planet who paints its beauty and speaks so slowly that conversation takes patience; his mind is said to see the whole universe, and rumour calls him older than his own order's founders.

feats.scene: Torcor, after a very long pause, projects a green lance that pierces a drifting warship hull.
Torcor drifts for years in open space with nothing but his own patience to keep him alive.

reply.summary: Ceoliti is a small, fungus-bodied peacekeeper stationed on a distant hub world, armed with a power ring that builds shields, weapons and wings of light; his will is steady and his manner gentle.

feats.scene: Ceoliti hurls a green construct hammer that flattens a pirate cruiser's engine block.
Ceoliti sits inside a ring force field as raiders pound it for an hour.

reply.summary: Varre is a mechanical menace built to echo every ability of a team of heroes; when a catastrophe strips all living wonders of their gifts, its metal body stays whole and it tries to profit from the chaos.

feats.scene: Varre rips a bank vault door from its hinges and flings it across a street.
Varre keeps marching through a tank barrage that scorches its plating.

reply.summary: Anstrn is a red-eyed machine that borrows any ability it witnesses, from spinning cyclones to bendy limbs and ghostly passage; it is pieced together by a scheming inventor and turns up whenever he wants a fight.

feats.scene: Anstrn fires a stolen atomic blast that melts a lab's concrete roof.
Anstrn endures a hero's thrown wreckage and keeps advancing with one arm hanging loose.
Anstrn copies a speedster's gait and crosses a warehouse in a blink.

reply.summary: Nuntevi is a hulking guard-robot with burning eyes and a heavy punch, steered by a tiny pilot from inside its head; it is deployed to quash a jailbreak at a villains' lockup.

feats.scene: Nuntevi blasts a cell wall with a beam from its eyes until the bricks glow.
Nuntevi absorbs a prisoner's fire-blast and its paint blisters.

reply.summary: Annau is an eight-foot artificial man whose absorbent cells let him mimic the gifts of every hero he meets. Built by an immortality-obsessed inventor, he outgrows his orders and nurses a bitter rivalry with a time-lost hourglass hero.

feats.scene: Annau mimics a flying hero's strength and drives a fist through a bridge pylon.
Annau sits in a sealed chamber for years and walks out undamaged.

reply.summary: Tellluinu is a synthetic copy-engine created as an experiment long before any hero alliance existed; it later becomes a pawn of villain syndicates and infiltrates a floating hero base to test a lone masked fighter.

feats.scene: Tellluinu blasts a hole through a satellite hull using a power it has just copied.
Tellluinu is scattered into pieces and keeps twitching in separate crates.

reply.summary: Ceolltum is a bronze machine from a dead cosmos who burns his own planet, then slaughters every living thing he finds before swallowing a doctrine of despair; he batters the walls of a mirror chamber until reality shudders across many worlds.

feats.scene: Ceolltum shatters his home world into drifting rubble with one concentrated surge.
Ceolltum keeps pounding a barrier of living mirrors that would flatten a sun.

reply.summary: Levaes is a plant-descended mercenary hired to fill a corporate strike team after its young members are dismissed. Little is known about her beyond a steady paycheck and a quiet temper.

feats.scene: Levaes whips a thorned vine across a security door and splinters it.
Levaes takes a hard fall onto concrete and stands up without complaint.

reply.summary: Stirnirus is a teenage flyer from a small city who helps a boy cross the country when the usual shortcuts fail. At midnight on her birthday she is flung into another world and plummets until a hero catches her.

feats.scene: Stirnirus hauls the throttle back and pulls a light aircraft out of a dive.
Stirnirus survives a terrifying drop through open sky before being scooped up.
Stirnirus pushes her little plane to full speed across the coast.

reply.summary: Rumte is a blond young woman bred as one of a new generation of engineered fighters, whose body splits into endless duplicates; her copies are used as targets until she escapes and joins other runaways.

feats.scene: Rumte splits into a dozen copies that all tackle a guard at once.
Rumte endures a firing range of rifles as the targets are replaced by fresh duplicates.

reply.summary: Stnira is a blond, wisecracking dabbler in dark arts who bears a strong resemblance to a famous trenchcoated conjurer; he tracks a loose fiend to a suburban house and distracts it while a friend slips away.

feats.scene: Stnira chalks a binding sigil and sends a minor fiend tumbling across a kitchen.
Stnira tumbles down a flight of stairs and keeps up his patter.

reply.summary: Tieon is a thundering showoff who gains the power to drain current from any wire after a cosmic accident; he speaks in a grandiose old-fashioned way and conjures serpents of crackling light.

feats.scene: Tieon sends a bolt of lightning through a subway tunnel and blows out the lights of a whole district.
Tieon is overloaded by a rail's raw current and vanishes in white fire.

reply.summary: Amvas is a monocled schemer who plans to steal a legendary youth-giving spring by sneaking a gullible accomplice onto a guarded island; the plot collapses when the water dries up the moment an outsider reaches for it.

feats.scene: Amvas jams a hidden radio in a coat pocket to steer his accomplice along the shore.
Amvas stumbles into a thorn hedge and comes out only scratched.

reply.summary: Soniarvar is a nervous, brown-haired camera operator who follows a news reporter into a strange story; he is happiest when he is filming and has no special gift beyond a steady hand.

feats.scene: Soniarvar swings his heavy camera rig into a thug's elbow.
Soniarvar bounces off a van door and still gets the shot.

reply.summary: Lanumror is a polite money manager for a crime family in daylight and a purple-haired road racer after dark. A fiend borrows her body and turns her tidy life upside down, so she carries a grudge against its human partner.

feats.scene: Lanumror channels the fiend and flips a speeding sports car across three lanes.
Lanumror walks away from a high-speed wreck with only a cracked lip.
Lanumror hits top speed on a night highway with her engine screaming.

reply.summary: Rainsi is the daughter of a cooking-pot costumed vigilante and joins a gang of kid helpers; she grows up to marry and keeps the family's scrappy habit of jumping into trouble.

feats.scene: Rainsi hurls a bucket of flour into a burglar's face.
Rainsi gets knocked off a fence and bounces right back up.

reply.summary: Vamonmil is a former pickpocket revived after being run down by a truck and rebuilt with a strange metal; she steals kinetic force from anything she touches and turns it into brief bursts of velocity.

feats.scene: Vamonmil siphons the motion from a charging bruiser and slams into a wall at full speed.
Vamonmil survives a truck collision on a city street before her rebuilding.
Vamonmil dashes down an alley powered by stolen momentum.

reply.summary: Tilnolneo is an ancient desert priest-sorcerer who fakes his death by sleeping through the centuries, then wakes in modern times intending to rule; his spells prove no match for a stage magician, and his body is blown to powder.

feats.scene: Tilnolneo calls down a sandstorm that peels the roof from a stone temple.
Tilnolneo is reduced to dust by a counter-spell and scatters on the wind.

reply.summary: Ticolas is a tall, shaven angel sent to drag a prodigal sibling home, who ends up a father, a patrol officer and finally a ruler of paradise; he can slow time around him and cannot be slain by ordinary means.

feats.scene: Ticolas smashes through a concrete overpass with one heavenly shove.
Ticolas stands unmoved as a fuel depot erupts around him.

reply.summary: Sorcorleo is a proud, white-haired angel of an upper choir who despises a rebel sibling and sets out to wipe him from existence; he leads a doomed host against a doorway to an empty creation and refuses to bend even when his side takes heavy losses.

feats.scene: Sorcorleo hurls a lance of holy light that levels a hillside.
Sorcorleo stands against a rebel's blazing counter-attack and only steps back once.

reply.summary: Liaer is a patriotic super-soldier from a distant race who leads a squad of avengers and rallies fighters from across many worlds against an invading darkness; he is eventually undone when a warlord's schemes ignite a nuclear war.

feats.scene: Liaer punches through a rival's armoured hull and caves in a wall of the city.
Liaer holds his ground against a rain of alien artillery.

reply.summary: Ntoamo is a flag-draped militia man in an exaggerated costume who leads armed followers against newcomers at a harbour monument; he is stopped by a team of strong heroes before his scheme does lasting harm.

feats.scene: Ntoamo clubs a startled bystander with the butt of a rifle.
Ntoamo is tossed across a pier and breaks his fall on the rail.

reply.summary: Iltor is a blond princess with violet eyes who sits on a panel of royals that coach a friend through a ritual combat; she is quick to bow when the friend wins.

feats.scene: Iltor flicks a gem-tipped wand and sends a gilded chair skidding across a throne room.
Iltor is knocked back by a sparring blow and shakes it off with a laugh.

reply.summary: Luall is a pink-skinned warrior of a conquering race who rises to forge weapons for her empire; when she learns her masters serve a darker patron, she defects and ends up raising a child for a tycoon.

feats.scene: Luall hammers a glowing blade into shape and cuts a steel plate in half.
Luall wades through a blaster volley behind a forged shield.

reply.summary: Niutil is a white-haired colonial sorceress burned for her craft, who lays a curse that lets her possess her own descendants. Through them she hunts the heirs of her killers for centuries.

feats.scene: Niutil hurls a ghostly flame that brings down the beams of an old academy hall.
Niutil is burned at the stake yet her spirit keeps whispering from the ashes.

reply.summary: Riatavar is the calm, brown-haired chief of a hidden settlement who greets a stranger as a long-awaited saviour; he has a daughter and a settled belief that destiny sent his guest.

feats.scene: Riatavar shoves open a heavy timber gate to welcome the visitor.
Riatavar stands firm as a gust of dust sweeps through the village square.

reply.summary: Cecer is a yellow-skinned, orange-haired space guardian who is drafted alongside her spouse the very day they wed; she gives birth mid-battle, then quits the order for love and settles at home with her family.

feats.scene: Cecer fires a ring beam that pins a fanatical hunter against a hull.
Cecer wraps her newborn in a ring shield as the fight rages around them.

reply.summary: Laseolium is a physicist who stumbles into a pocket cosmos during an experiment and becomes a walking pocket cosmos himself, with rules of his own; he drifts between his private space and ordinary reality and joins a secretive league.

feats.scene: Laseolium opens his private cosmos wide and swallows a collapsing tower block.
Laseolium lets a rocket strike pass through him as if he were a mirage.

reply.summary: Nauirnium is a dark-haired chemist who drinks a serum that lets him split into copies of himself; he commits offences across a dozen cities simultaneously until an antidote ends the scheme.

feats.scene: Nauirnium and a dozen duplicates empty several vaults in the same minute.
Nauirnium is hammered by a flying hero and dissolves back into one body.

reply.summary: Niuta is an ambitious northern thug who wants fame by beating the strongest hero in the city. A stolen boost makes him fearsome for a while, until the surge of energy inside him overloads and kills him.

feats.scene: Niuta explodes in a final blast that takes the front off a warehouse.
Niuta takes a punch that would fell a bull and keeps swinging.

reply.summary: Lennti is a pink-skinned brute from a warlike race who joins an interstellar police force despite the distrust of his kin; when he returns home his reputation is wrecked, so he becomes a hired gun.

feats.scene: Lennti flings a rioter through a plank barricade with one arm.
Lennti brushes off a barrage of stun rounds in a crowded plaza.

reply.summary: Tontau is a prince who thinks himself a living deity after receiving a borrowed gift of lightning and flight. Grief over his sister's death pushes him to vote for annihilating both sides of a war with a beam from orbit.

feats.scene: Tontau calls down a spear of lightning that bursts a bridge span.
Tontau walks out of a collapsed palace wing without a mark.

reply.summary: Rnnin is a white-haired swindler who gains a gift for reading and bending minds after being tortured by alien scientists; when calm he can persuade people of nearly anything, and he joins a roving band of survivors.

feats.scene: Rnnin murmurs a story into a guard's mind and the man unlocks a gate.
Rnnin survives an ordeal of flames that kills most of the captives.

reply.summary: Ntonumst is a cruel organ-collecting killer from a volcanic planet who is recruited into a fear-powered army; he prefers his glowing ring to his fists and slips back home to resume his crimes.

feats.scene: Ntonumst fires a yellow ring blast that pierces a landing craft.
Ntonumst shrugs off a counter-volley behind a ring shell.

reply.summary: Vaeru is a smiling gangster in one century and a galaxy-spanning tyrant in another, who claims to be older than time; her swarming minions kill half a team of heroes while she takes a world with ease.

feats.scene: Vaeru erases a fleet of warships with a wave of her hand.
Vaeru lets a champion's strongest blow land on her and smiles.

reply.summary: Cocelone is a small brown-and-white capuchin who is the only male creature left alive after a plague wipes out the rest; he tags along with his owner as a loyal companion.

feats.scene: Cocelone swats a fruit off a high branch and into his owner's lap.
Cocelone rides out the plague that kills every other male, showing no fever.

reply.summary: Sanlanval is a blue-haired black-market boss who runs a hidden trading ring for outlaws and wipes the memories of anyone who leaves. After altering her ex-partner's potion, she can graft steel onto skin and sculpt it.

feats.scene: Sanlanval merges a steel girder into her arm and swings it through a wall.
Sanlanval takes a flurry of blows on a hardened metal forearm.

reply.summary: Talnumll is a silver-skinned fighter whose body is coated in a quantum metal, granting near invulnerability, strength, flight and bursts of concussive energy; she joins a young team briefly, then leaves to chase her own agenda.

feats.scene: Talnumll blasts a rival's armoured tank with a concussive burst over the sea.
Talnumll is hit by a tank shell and takes no harm.
Talnumll streaks over the waves toward a battle.

reply.summary: Arniaamo is a tiny silver-haired schoolkid who treats jeans and a shirt as a perfect costume and shows off a shiny armour skin; she lives in a toddler town of heroes and has a stubborn obsession.

feats.scene: Arniaamo bops a toy robot over a sandbox fence.
Arniaamo bounces off a playground slide with a metallic ring.

reply.summary: Tircor is a fifteen-year-old bullied at school who talks to a beetle, leaks strange strange ooze out of her soles, and discovers she can command round objects by calling up her moments of shame. Squares are her enemies and circles her friends.

feats.scene: Tircor hurls a rolling ball that bursts the locker of a bully.
Tircor is chased across a schoolyard by a square-headed tormentor and trips but gets up.

reply.summary: Tater is a blond woman from a rough, disreputable world who falls into a grubby lifestyle and lures a former sweetheart home as bait; her betrayal ends in her murder at the hands of a space-bound villain.

feats.scene: Tater slaps a stranger across the face on a dim street.
Tater is killed by a single strike from a schemer.

reply.summary: Llriarni is a warrior of an island sisterhood who trains a visiting young hero and stays friendly with her even after they end up on opposite sides; she is skilled with bow, horse and blade.

feats.scene: Llriarni shoots an arrow through a straw target at full gallop.
Llriarni takes a hit from a rival's spear shaft and keeps riding.

reply.summary: Mioll is a blue-eyed partisan who works with allied troops during a long war and fails in an attempt to kill a brutal officer; she is caught and shot, and the cloak she wore passes to a teenager who avenges her.

feats.scene: Mioll fires a pistol at an officer's motorcade from a hay barn.
Mioll is beaten in a cell and refuses to speak.

reply.summary: Ntocol is a troubled man who invents a fantasy of being a vengeful time traveller, wears a centurion-like costume and carries a doctored pistol that he swears is a futuristic ray; he has no true powers, only a deep grudge.

feats.scene: Ntocol fires his doctored handgun at a statue and chips the stone.
Ntocol tumbles off a ledge in his costume and crawls away.

reply.summary: Cisnte is a trickster deity of a savannah people, known only by name to the heroes who inherit a gifted totem from him; he is distant, amused and rarely seen.

feats.scene: Cisnte conjures a dust devil that flattens a village market in an instant.
Cisnte laughs as a collapsing hillside passes harmlessly through him.
